Definition: Chilhijah, the name of eight Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hilkiah = "my portion is Jehovah"; 1) father of Eliakim, an officer of Hezekiah; 2) high priest in the reign of Josiah; 3) a Merarite Levite, son of Amzi; 4) another Merarite Levite, 2nd son of Hosah; 5) one of those who stood on the right of Ezra when he read the law and probably a Levite and a priest; 6) a priest of Anathoth, father of the prophet Jeremiah; 7) father of Gemariah who was one of Zedekiah's envoys to Babylon
